title: Apple Cider Vinegar: Fat‑Melting Myth?

scenes.text: Does a tablespoon of apple cider vinegar melt belly fat overnight?
The popular claim says ACV speeds up fat loss just by sipping it daily.
scenes.label: ACV burns fat fast

scenes.text: Scientific studies find no direct fat‑burning effect; ACV may modestly curb appetite but isn’t a weight‑loss shortcut.
scenes.label: No direct fat‑burning effect
scenes.query: research paper on ACV and weight

scenes.text: Use ACV sparingly for flavor, not as a diet miracle.
scenes.label: Flavor, not miracle
scenes.sub: Add to salads, limit to a tablespoon

scenes.text: Follow for daily tips to feel your best.

description: We separate fact from fiction on apple cider vinegar and weight loss. Discover what the research actually says and how to use ACV wisely. Follow for more myth‑busting nutrition insights.
